evidence.note: Dec 1996 capture of the Perth 'PSInet Pty Ltd' website (Subiaco WA) - the site ran from Dec 1996 and was a parked domain by 2007.

evidence.quote: listed it on the Australian Securities Exchange in September 1999 ... With new capital, iiNet acquired its major local competitors in the Perth area, including Wantree Internet and Omen Internet, and several smaller competitors like Networx Internet, Infinite Data, Octal, and Net Trek Online Services.
evidence.note: Establishes the Sept 1999 post-IPO Perth acquisition spree that the PSInet sale is placed within.

evidence.quote: iiNet merges with Wantree, the second largest ISP in WA. Directly following the listing, iiNet rapidly acquires Omen Internet, Networx, Nettrek and Infinite Data in Perth, as well as regional service providers MNS and Comtech.
evidence.note: iiNet's own timeline of its 1999 acquisitions - PSInet is not named explicitly, so the link rests mainly on the founder's record.

misattribution_note: iiNet's history and Wikipedia do not name 'PSInet' among the 1999 Perth acquisitions, so the exact date is not independently verifiable (the brief relies on Mark Siena's LinkedIn founder record). psinet.net.au (live 1996-1998 as PSInet Pty Ltd, Subiaco) is the Perth company, distinct from US PSINet; psinet.com.au has no captures.
